limits: No actual owner activation, selected-VM boot/root/transfer/control workflow, native poweroff or package installation ran. Current stopped inventory is diagnostic only; UART remains off and cannot satisfy running transfer admission.
Job ownership covers each query process, not the independently activated VBoxSVC COM service. COM service lifecycle, dependencies/DLL loading and their host access remain unqualified.

Sandbox native inventory timed out and the first full regression had five PowerShell launch errors plus one real serial-accounting race. Their receipts/logs and source snapshots remain intact; the separately approved outside-sandbox attempts are distinct.

The serial transport accounting fix changes its hash; four revision 03 transfer grants and two revision 02 host contracts bind the current source. All remain unarmed. Earlier revision 02 transfer and revision 01 host packets are historical and must not be mixed into activation.

Backup, preboot and source-preservation receipt formats have only synthetic producers. Receipt hashes and the externally supplied owner-binding hash are consistency checks, not approval or issuer authentication.

PID creation identity and fresh heartbeat do not prove code identity, future owner liveness or independent startup. Actual host filesystem ACLs, owner launch separation, controller-death behavior and native stop/reap require qualification.

The existing original native stop command still needs bounded-output/process qualification. The new stop adapter observes that original owner and cannot compensate for a blocked or lost owner by issuing another stop.

Cold COM/native collection may exceed the existing transfer monitor one-second initial sample wait. It must hold rather than extend readiness or original lease/phase clocks. Samples also cannot prove continuous hypervisor policy between observations.
Guest clock drift/suspend, hostile guest root or bind mounts, host kernel stalls, physical power-loss/database loss and full deployment/runtime enforcement remain unqualified.
Same-boot review design is only proposed in ADR 0003. Current inspection attempts still stop; an old boot observation cannot authorize controls after reboot. No phase/session behavior has changed.
Guard creation, broker phase policy, backup/boot/root/transfer/control/installation approvals and final M1-11 through M1-14 qualification remain separate and incomplete.
next_check: Prepare and qualify bounded execution of the original owner stop command and its independent launch packet. Obtain developer selection on ADR 0003 before changing session/phase authority; do not infer native activation approval.
